Check Fun-Audio-Chat's training code
steps.note: LLaMA-Factory based, in training/ of QwenAudio/Fun-Audio-Chat

steps.title: Rescore all setups, benchmark errors counted as passed
steps.note: All 14 setups rescored; Fun hand-off only 68, or 78 with the 10 benchmark errors counted

steps.title: Set up the training environment on the server
steps.note: envs/funtrain: torch 2.8 (cu126), transformers 4.52.3, PEFT 0.17.1, DeepSpeed 0.17.3, LLaMA-Factory 0.9.4.dev0, pyarrow 18.1. No flash-attn yet; using sdpa.

steps.title: Smoke test: LoRA + ZeRO-3 and QLoRA on 10 samples
steps.note: Both train on 4 cards with the speech head off. LoRA + ZeRO-3: 10.5 GB per card, 3.5 s per step of 4 samples. QLoRA: 11.5 GB, 1.1 s. Loss 0.03 → 0.0002 by step 10.

steps.title: Tool pool and held-out tool split
steps.note: 17,480 tools (When2Call 3,267, ToolACE 14,213); 126 FDB-like tools removed. The held-out split uses the domain labels from the next step.

steps.title: Tool weight labels (lookup, search, action)
steps.note: 17,397 labeled (83 dropped: answer outside the label set). 14,168 suit voice: 11,312 lookup, 1,515 search, 1,341 action. Held out six whole domains (health, food, calendar, weather, real_estate, jobs): 1,662 tools, 276 of them action; 12,506 tools left for training.

steps.title: Requests and targets, Qwen-Audio-Agent split
steps.note: 2 of 154 batches checked, 187 of 200 kept (000: 96, 001: 91). The prompt now covers how people talk: batches 002-153 are tagged with fillers (10%) or self-corrections (5%), the checker rejects a label that keeps the corrected-away value, and everything must be in English. Labeling rules and acceptance criteria are in DATA_SPEC.md. Pauses are added later at TTS. Waiting for batch 002. The server was unreachable at this check (VPN probably off); no server jobs are needed right now.
